name: Markdownify MCP
headline: Markdownify-mcp: Convert Content to Markdown Easily
short_description: Markdownify-mcp is a powerful server that converts various content formats into Markdown, enhancing documentation and content creation workflows. Built with TypeScript, it uses the Model Context Protocol for efficient processing.
author: zcaceres

sections.overview:
markdownify-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that transforms multiple content formats into Markdown, enabling efficient documentation and content creation workflows. Built with TypeScript, it leverages the markitdown library to handle format conversions and integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor through the MCP stdio transport. The skill supports file-based conversions—notably PDF to Markdown—and includes Docker deployment options for containerized environments. Developers benefit from automated format conversion that preserves content structure and formatting, streamlining documentation pipelines and content processing tasks.
Convert technical documentation from PDF to Markdown for easier editing and sharing.
Transform meeting notes into Markdown format for streamlined collaboration among team members.
Generate Markdown files from OCR outputs to digitize printed materials efficiently.
Create Markdown content for web articles, ensuring consistent formatting across platforms.
sections.usage:
```
Convert the following [CONTENT] from [SOURCE_FORMAT] to Markdown using the markdownify-mcp server. Ensure the output maintains the original structure and formatting. Include any necessary metadata or frontmatter based on the context provided.
